_readme: Public tournament bank for Dr Awing. Maps a Raiden tournament to the public page
its scraper value is taken from. Contains only organiser-published tournament
names and public URLs — no internal identifiers beyond the tournament number,
Matching order: raidenId, then exact name, then pattern.
raidenId  the tournament number Raiden shows (tournament-6927 -> 6927).
Preferred: internal names are often abbreviated (ECL SA s54) and
never match the source's wording. Changes each season, but so
does the source URL, so the pairing had to be redone anyway.
name      exact tournament name, case-insensitive. Fallback when no id.
pattern   regular expression. Best for status:none rules that outlive
season numbers, where there is no URL to keep current.
url       the page to take the scraper value from
status    'none' = no usable source exists; its matches stop being flagged
for everyone, instead of each person muting it again every week.
Add entries at the end. Dr Awing's Bank tab produces ready-made lines.
